_meta.description: Declarative manifest-v2 navigation for the Tier-2 KOR capability (Task 22). Adds four entries under the existing Belastingen menu: KorAanmelding (opt-in flow as an index of draft KORRegistrations), KorDashboard (drempel-benutting + alerts overview), KorDrempelMonitor (KORAnnualTurnover detail with monthly breakdown, prognose, alert-history), and KorOpzegging (opt-out flow as an index of ACTIEF KORRegistrations past their vroegsteOpzegDatum). All four are pure config rendered by the nc-vue manifest-v2 shell (createObjectStore against the shillinq register) — no Vue components, no router (ADR-024 / manifest-v2). The pre-existing KorStatus + KorStatusDetail entries (driven by the legacy KorRegime schema) are deliberately untouched and co-exist.

config._note_rowRoute: `detailRoute` is inert; the implicit fallback matches a `type:"detail"` page by register+schema and KorDrempelMonitor is bound to a different schema. The helpText below promises a click-through that did nothing without `rowRoute`.
config.helpText: Overview of all KOR registrations for this administration. Click through to the Threshold monitor to view real-time threshold utilization, monthly forecast and alert history (REQ-KOR-002, REQ-KOR-003).

config._note: REPORT/MONITOR archetype — a KOR annual-turnover record tracks a registration's running turnover against the small-business threshold in real time. Native shillinq detail contract: config.aggregations[] surface the three money/utilization KPIs (running turnover, year-end forecast, threshold utilization) so a bookkeeper instantly sees whether the threshold is at risk; config.fields[] render the full turnover data (year, threshold, per-month breakdown, excluded items, forecast status); and the bespoke KOR sidebarProps (alert-history list filtered by registrationId + audit trail) is preserved verbatim — the correct home for the threshold-alert log. NO comms/files — this is a computed monitor, not a document.
